AI agents MUST NOT be listed as authors or co-authors of git commits.
Do NOT use `Co-authored-by:` trailers for AI agents
Do NOT add AI agents to commit author fields
The human developer who reviews and commits the code is the sole author
This is a FINOS-wide policy that applies to all projects under the FINOS umbrella.

Scala 3.7.4; Mill 1.1.x; ZIO; ScalaJS; experimental Scala Native. Areas: `build.mill`, `mill-build/src/`, `morphir/`, `.config/mise/`, `project/`.

mise run setup
mise run lint
mise run fmt
mise run test:jvm
mise run test:js
mise run ci:local

./mill morphir[3.7.4].jvm.compile
./mill morphir[3.7.4].jvm.test
./mill mill.scalalib.scalafmt.ScalafmtModule/reformatAll 'morphir.__.sources'
./mill morphir[3.7.4].__.jvm.test

Cross-platform dirs: `src/`, `jvm/src/`, `js/src/`, `src-3/`, `jvm/src-3.7/`. scalafmt 3.10.4, Scala 3 dialect, 120 columns. Run `mise run fmt` before committing. Use `given`/`using`; prefer `enum`, `derives`, `extension`; import with `*`; use `mvn""`, not `ivy""
